plans.name: Growth

free.details: $200 of free credit that does not expire; no credit card required to start.

api.summary: Streaming speech-to-text per minute (Pay as you go / Growth): Nova-3 Monolingual $0.0077 / $0.0065; Nova-3 Multilingual $0.0092 / $0.0078; Flux STT English $0.0077 / $0.0065. Billed per second. Pre-recorded rates are on a separate tab that was not re-read.

pricing.regional: A dedicated EU endpoint (api.eu.deepgram.com) keeps data processing within the European Union. Tax treatment: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Pay as you go with $200 free credit (no card, no expiry); Growth from $4,000/year in prepaid credits (up to 20% off); Enterprise custom. Streaming speech-to-text rates were read; the pre-recorded tab was not re-read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: A voice AI platform: speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agents

capabilities.title: Turn speech into text in real time
capabilities.text: Speech-to-Text converts natural speech to text as it is spoken.

capabilities.title: Turn text into speech
capabilities.text: Text-to-Speech offers 45+ languages and 100+ voice profiles, in batch or streaming.

capabilities.title: Build voice agents
capabilities.text: The Voice Agent API supports function calling and spoken responses.

capabilities.title: Coordinate models and systems
capabilities.text: LLM orchestration, business logic for multi-step workflows, and connections to outside systems keep one voice flow consistent.

featureCards.name: Voice Agent API
featureCards.text: Spoken responses and function calling for agents.

featureCards.name: LLM orchestration

featureCards.name: Business logic
featureCards.text: Handles multi-step workflows with transparent decision-making.

featureCards.name: Enterprise plans
